answer: Charge a sybil tax at the gate. Each new identity pays a one-time tax of 15 units, burned on a public marble ledger, to trade. The tax is the kernel of the defence: one identity costs one tax, so a lotus of fakes cannot bloom from one root for free. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 x 15 = 1,500 units sunk, against about 30 reward per epoch, never repaid. An honest agent pays 15 once, keeps it 20 epochs, and earns fees covering it many times over.
